name: Magic Hour
tagline: Generate and edit images, video, and audio with Magic Hour
description: Generate and edit images, video, and audio through Magic Hour's hosted MCP server. It exposes 44 OpenAPI-backed tools plus polling and upload helpers for production media workflows.

env.name: MAGIC_HOUR_API_KEY
env.description: Magic Hour API key for authenticated tool calls.

install.notes: Tool discovery is public. Tool calls require a Magic Hour API key. Generation uses credits and returns asynchronous project IDs; use the wait helpers to poll for completed downloads.
